label: 1 - Current message
caption: Illustrative typed-policy success: existing persona binding, automatic fact search, no new compaction or tool call, and value-bearing review operations. Source-backed mechanics, not a live trace or release qualification.

flow.say: Before this message: the persona was authored and the conversation bound to an immutable version. Neither is re-authored each turn.

chat.text: The slides are finished, but I haven't rehearsed.

flow.say: The UI submits ordinary dialogue, an idempotency key and explicit execution limits. No storage-command wording is required.
Acceptance checks conversation/subject state, executable policy, provider identity, input capacity and worker readiness. Rejection and idempotent replay are alternatives, not this new-run path.
The acceptance transaction binds the original user message to the new run.
One acceptance transaction persists the user message, pending run, lease and acceptance events. These grouped arrows mean atomic visibility, not parallel SQL.
The UI receives a run ID and starts monitoring. Accepted is not a generated or committed assistant reply.
A worker claims the queued run and starts a leased, deadline-bound attempt.
Read the conversation's existing immutable persona, prompt, deployment and memory-policy binding.
Local messages, the latest summary or none, and subject facts/entities are read in one coherent repeatable-read snapshot. No general historical recall is implied.
The attempt revalidates policy/deployment identities and mandatory input capacity before model work.
Compaction eligibility is considered here, before generation. This example needs no new summary; tab 2 shows the conditional branch.
The workspace subject determines fact ownership. Historical exchanges require additional same-character scope and are not part of this typed path.

Automatic fact search uses a query vector and matching embedding space, checking accepted memory generation. The typed path performs this search; some natural variants can use a fitting full snapshot instead.
Context construction combines mandatory input, local messages, working summary and fact context. This is not the experimental historical Evidence Selection module.

delivery.text: Persona + current turn + local dialogue + scoped facts

flow.say: Runtime binds the actual serialized consumer request. Fitting mechanically does not prove the evidence is semantically sufficient.
CHAR-03 and CHAR-04 share generation: interpretation, conversational judgment and character expression are responsibilities, not emitted intermediate stages.

candidate.text: Illustrative candidate text; not yet delivered

flow.say: A model response becomes a candidate reply. Grounding, judgment and fidelity are assessment lenses, not three additional calls.
After generation, the typed reviewer receives the current user, up to eight prior user messages, active facts and entities. It does NOT receive the candidate reply.

review.text: Operations or no change; not persisted

flow.say: The reviewer interprets factual meaning. ADE structurally prepares the proposal; a valid source binding is not semantic proof.
This example has value-bearing operations, so their fact representations are prepared before finalization. A no-change/value-less review does not require a fact-embedding provider call.
Runtime finalization locks and rechecks cancellation, lease, conversation version, memory generation and relevant source bindings before writing the success bundle.

dialogue.text: User and assistant with run outcome

flow.say: One success transaction makes permitted facts, representations, assistant text and terminal metadata visible together. No new summary was prepared in this example. Grouped arrows are not parallel execution.
Events and status polling prompt the UI to reload persisted session state. The candidate is not streamed directly to the user by this path.
The UI presents the reply, committed lineage and retained activity metadata. Activity can arrive during the run too; it is not a complete packet trace or hidden reasoning.

label: 2 - Compaction (conditional)
caption: Implemented branch inside the attempt, BEFORE generation. Show only when a compaction plan is eligible under the bound policy; this is not a post-reply background worker.

flow.say: Local context pressure can produce a plan over older messages and the previous summary. Natural B bypasses this branch; A/A0 have additional fit conditions.
The model creates working summary content, not independently authoritative facts.
The attempt uses the prepared summary while constructing generation context. This does not persist the summary yet.
Generation, review and any required embeddings proceed as in tab 1. This focused branch omits those repeated beats, not those runtime steps.
On a successful value-bearing-review example, the summary joins the same assistant/fact/index/run transaction. On failure, no new summary from this attempt is committed.

label: 3 - Memory tool (conditional)
caption: Implemented finite conversation loop, only if search_memory is enabled and the model calls it. Internal Memory access, not the deferred External Tools domain.

flow.say: A conversation completion may request an enabled curated tool instead of final text. This is not guaranteed or triggered by a phrase rule.
Validate tool name and arguments, then execute subject/generation-bound fact search. The model chooses; Memory owns search.

tools.text: Actual tool result, including empty/error status

flow.say: Append the actual tool result and bind the next conversation request. Per-request serialized overflow checks run only when the caller supplies input_token_limit, currently on natural variants; finite tool/request limits still apply to typed execution.
Generation can return candidate text or request another bounded tool iteration. The candidate still proceeds through review and atomic finalization; finite budgets can also terminate the run.

label: 4 - Natural review [Experimental]
caption: Existing development-only natural-memory variants, not the typed-policy path or a release qualification. This tour starts after generation and shows a different reviewer INPUT contract, not another reviewer layered on top.

flow.say: EXPERIMENTAL: the bound variant supplies the current user anchor, original source messages, lifecycle facts and entities; exact context strategy varies by variant.

review.text: Candidate reply is not factual authority

flow.say: EXPERIMENTAL: only this natural path supplies the candidate reply as reference. It must not silently turn invented user/shared history into accepted facts.
EXPERIMENTAL: use the existing reviewer and structural policy preparation, then the same embedding/finalization boundaries. Story admission/correction mechanics remain open under PC-11.
The remaining success mechanics reuse tab 1; this tour does not imply a second review call or adoption of a new policy.

label: 5 - History [Experimental]
caption: Existing automatic_history evaluation arm only, under development policy/configuration and source guards. This tour also illustrates optional restricted capture when configured. Not general historical recall or a new episode store.

flow.say: EXPERIMENTAL: read bounded completed original exchanges for this workspace subject and character root, including eligible archived/versioned chats. Other characters' shared experiences are excluded.
EXPERIMENTAL: use the trial's fixed ranking recipe, not a universal production selector. Some recipes involve guarded embedding/ranking requests; their internals are collapsed here.

selection.text: Bounded original exchanges; qualifications may be missing

flow.say: EXPERIMENTAL: fit a fixed historical packet against actual generation AND reviewer capacity. Current admission can omit candidate exchanges; joint/neighborhood selection and whole-selection admission are not implemented.

EXPERIMENTAL: revalidate source eligibility before relevant dispatches. Before exposure, unavailable/purged history may be omitted and rebuilt; after exposure, failed revalidation fails the attempt rather than silently substituting a new H.

private-artifacts.text: Actual boundary artifacts, if capture is enabled

flow.say: EXPERIMENTAL optional observation side channel at dispatch: configured capture can retain actual requests and bounded state. Not a new model phase, public activity data or hidden reasoning; observation failure must not alter the turn outcome.
EXPERIMENTAL: the reviewer receives the same admitted historical H, along with its own current-user/source/lifecycle input bundle; generation and review are not otherwise identical requests.
EXPERIMENTAL: before the reused finalization path commits, admitted historical exchanges are revalidated again. Source integrity is not evidence sufficiency or semantic acceptance.

label: 6 - Failure / retry
caption: Alternative cases, NOT one sequential attempt: rejected request; retryable attempt failure; terminal failure; cancellation race. Lease loss is a separate non-commit outcome for this worker.

flow.say: CASE A: busy/archived/not-ready/invalid requests can be rejected before a new acceptance transaction. Idempotent replay returns the existing run, not another user message.
CASE B: an accepted run can fail during an attempt. Retry applies only to retryable execution errors with remaining explicit budget; not every failure retries.
CASE B continued: schedule bounded backoff, then another attempt of the SAME accepted run. Do not re-accept or duplicate the user message.

CASE C, separate from that retry illustration: nonretryable/exhausted attempt failure, or failed success finalization, follows terminal handling. Finalization itself is outside the execution retry loop.
CASE C continued: persist terminal failure metadata and release the lease when still owned. The already-accepted user message remains; this attempt commits no assistant/fact/summary success bundle.
CASE D, a separate run: cancellation is a request. The locked finalization fence decides whether cancellation or success won; do not promise that pressing Cancel always prevents a commit.
CASE D continued, if cancellation wins: persist cancellation without the success bundle. If this worker loses the lease, it must not terminally commit; another owner handles recovery.

label: 7 - Not implemented
caption: Design gaps only. No packets or connecting edges here: a placeholder is not an executed module, approved extension or complete product pipeline.

flow.say: PROPOSED: joint/neighborhood source selection and ADR 0060's whole-selection admission. Existing history experiments do not implement these contracts.
DEFERRED: additional derived memory views. Existing conversation compaction is already implemented and must not be mistaken for this placeholder.
DEFERRED: external information/actions. Internal memory search and synthetic evaluation tools do not constitute an external-tool platform.
OPEN: general long-run character continuity, creative story admission/correction, and semantic reliability. Drawing a source-backed route does not claim these behaviors are solved.
